declarations.description: Rozie's cross-framework port of Chart.js — the generic chart, whose `type` prop switches the chart kind across the whole Chart.js controller set.
declarations.name: Chart

members.name: data
members.description: Chart.js data in its own `{ labels, datasets }` shape. Reconciled **in place** on change — the wrapper mutates `chart.data` and calls `chart.update()` so series tween point-to-point instead of remounting.

members.name: options
members.description: Chart.js options (scales, legend, plugins config, …). Merged over the wrapper's responsive defaults and reapplied wholesale on change with `update('none')`. A consumer-supplied `options.onClick`/`onHover` is **composed**, not clobbered.

members.name: type
members.description: The chart kind — any Chart.js controller (`line`/`bar`/`pie`/`doughnut`/`radar`/`polarArea`/`scatter`/`bubble`/…). Changing it **re-creates** the instance, since Chart.js has no stable runtime type-swap.

members.name: height
members.description: Chart height in pixels, applied to the wrapper's host box; the canvas fills it responsively.

members.name: width
members.description: Optional fixed chart width in pixels. Omit for the default full-width responsive box.

members.name: plugins
members.description: Per-instance Chart.js `Plugin[]` — the consumer-extensibility passthrough. Merged into the config; changing the array **re-creates** the instance, since Chart.js has no stable runtime plugin-swap.

members.name: updateMode
members.description: The Chart.js `update` mode string used by the in-place data reconcile (e.g. `none` to skip the animation on every data tick).

members.name: redraw
members.description: When `true`, a `data` change **re-creates** the chart wholesale instead of reconciling in place — mirrors react-chartjs-2 `redraw` for charts whose plugins do not survive an in-place update.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible label applied to the `<canvas role="img">`, since canvas charts are otherwise opaque to assistive tech. For richer fallback content, fill the `fallback` slot.

members.name: datasetIdKey
members.description: The dataset-identity key (react-chartjs-2 parity). Across data updates, datasets are matched by `dataset[datasetIdKey]`, falling back to array index when the key is absent, so a stable keyed dataset reconciles onto its prior slot even if its index moved — guarding the "first dataset copied over the others" hazard.

members.name: destroyDelay
members.description: Milliseconds to defer `chart.destroy()` on unmount so an exit transition can finish (vue-chartjs parity). `0` (the default) destroys immediately.

members.name: getChart
members.description: Return the underlying Chart.js instance for direct API access (e.g. `getChart().update()`).

members.name: updateChart
members.description: Re-render the chart after mutating its data/options — `updateChart(mode?)` (Chart.js `update` mode string).

members.name: resizeChart
members.description: Resize the chart to its container, or to explicit dimensions — `resizeChart(width?, height?)`.

members.name: resetChart
members.description: Reset the chart elements to their initial (pre-animation) state.

members.name: renderChart
members.description: Re-render the chart from its current state without recalculating the scales.

members.name: stopChart
members.description: Stop the current animation loop (returns the instance).

members.name: clearChart
members.description: Clear the chart canvas (returns the instance).

members.name: toBase64Image
members.description: Export the current canvas as a base64-encoded PNG data URL — `toBase64Image(type?, quality?)`.

members.name: setDatasetVisibility
members.description: Set a dataset visible/hidden INSTANTLY — `setDatasetVisibility(datasetIndex, visible)`. Drives a custom external legend.

members.name: isDatasetVisible
members.description: Whether a dataset is currently visible — `isDatasetVisible(datasetIndex)`. Pairs with `setDatasetVisibility` for custom-legend styling.

members.name: hideDataset
members.description: Hide a dataset (or a single element) with ANIMATION — `hideDataset(datasetIndex, dataIndex?)` (Chart.js `hide`).

members.name: showDataset
members.description: Show a previously-hidden dataset (or element) with ANIMATION — `showDataset(datasetIndex, dataIndex?)` (Chart.js `show`).

members.name: setActiveElements
members.description: Programmatically set the active/hovered elements (open the tooltip from external interaction) — `setActiveElements([{ datasetIndex, index }])`.

members.name: getActiveElements
members.description: Return the currently active/hovered elements (mirror hover state into sibling UI).

members.name: getDatasetMeta
members.description: Return a dataset’s computed metadata (pixel geometry, controller) for positioning custom overlays — `getDatasetMeta(datasetIndex)`.

members.name: clearChart
members.description: Clear the chart canvas (returns the instance).

members.name: toBase64Image
members.description: Export the current canvas as a base64-encoded PNG data URL — `toBase64Image(type?, quality?)`.

members.name: setDatasetVisibility
members.description: Set a dataset visible/hidden INSTANTLY — `setDatasetVisibility(datasetIndex, visible)`. Drives a custom external legend.

members.name: isDatasetVisible
members.description: Whether a dataset is currently visible — `isDatasetVisible(datasetIndex)`. Pairs with `setDatasetVisibility` for custom-legend styling.

members.name: hideDataset
members.description: Hide a dataset (or a single element) with ANIMATION — `hideDataset(datasetIndex, dataIndex?)` (Chart.js `hide`).

members.name: showDataset
members.description: Show a previously-hidden dataset (or element) with ANIMATION — `showDataset(datasetIndex, dataIndex?)` (Chart.js `show`).

members.name: setActiveElements
members.description: Programmatically set the active/hovered elements (open the tooltip from external interaction) — `setActiveElements([{ datasetIndex, index }])`.

members.name: getActiveElements
members.description: Return the currently active/hovered elements (mirror hover state into sibling UI).

members.name: getDatasetMeta
members.description: Return a dataset’s computed metadata (pixel geometry, controller) for positioning custom overlays — `getDatasetMeta(datasetIndex)`.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Chart.js data in its own `{ labels, datasets }` shape. Reconciled **in place** on change — the wrapper mutates `chart.data` and calls `chart.update()` so series tween point-to-point instead of remounting.

attributes.name: options
attributes.description: Chart.js options (scales, legend, plugins config, …). Merged over the wrapper's responsive defaults and reapplied wholesale on change with `update('none')`. A consumer-supplied `options.onClick`/`onHover` is **composed**, not clobbered.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Chart height in pixels, applied to the wrapper's host box; the canvas fills it responsively.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Optional fixed chart width in pixels. Omit for the default full-width responsive box.

attributes.name: plugins
attributes.description: Per-instance Chart.js `Plugin[]` — the consumer-extensibility passthrough. Merged into the config; changing the array **re-creates** the instance, since Chart.js has no stable runtime plugin-swap.

attributes.name: updatemode
attributes.description: The Chart.js `update` mode string used by the in-place data reconcile (e.g. `none` to skip the animation on every data tick).

attributes.name: redraw
attributes.description: When `true`, a `data` change **re-creates** the chart wholesale instead of reconciling in place — mirrors react-chartjs-2 `redraw` for charts whose plugins do not survive an in-place update.

attributes.name: arialabel
attributes.description: Accessible label applied to the `<canvas role="img">`, since canvas charts are otherwise opaque to assistive tech. For richer fallback content, fill the `fallback` slot.

attributes.name: datasetidkey
attributes.description: The dataset-identity key (react-chartjs-2 parity). Across data updates, datasets are matched by `dataset[datasetIdKey]`, falling back to array index when the key is absent, so a stable keyed dataset reconciles onto its prior slot even if its index moved — guarding the "first dataset copied over the others" hazard.

attributes.name: destroydelay
attributes.description: Milliseconds to defer `chart.destroy()` on unmount so an exit transition can finish (vue-chartjs parity). `0` (the default) destroys immediately.

declarations.description: The PolarArea chart — Rozie's cross-framework port of Chart.js, pinned to `type: 'polarArea'` and registering only its own Chart.js controller set.
declarations.name: PolarArea
